title: Differential perm bialgebras, differential perm Yang-Baxter equation, and their applications in related bialgebra structures
summary: We introduce the differential perm bialgebras by generalizing the study of perm bialgebras to the context of differential perm algebras. They are characterized by the Manin triple of differential perm algebras as well as the matched pairs of differential perm algebras. The quasi-triangular (resp. triangular, factorizable) differential perm bialgebra are introduced.
